# The Pop-up Wedding Crèche

> The Pop-up Wedding Crèche is Sinead, an experienced childcare professional based in South West France who looks after children at weddings, events and on family holidays, so parents and guests can relax and enjoy the day.

## Services

- **Wedding Nanny**: One-to-one care for your child throughout your wedding day. Sinead blends in like a guest, helps with photoshoots and special jobs such as ring bearer, and liaises with you or your wedding planner.
- **Wedding Crèche**: A pop-up play space for groups of 2 to 5 children, set up in a self-contained room at your venue with games, toys, activities and a cosy corner for stories and naps. Large groups are not taken, to keep the quality of care consistent.
- **Holiday Nanny**: Individual or small-group childcare for up to 5 children during holidays, events and special occasions, either near where you are staying or accompanying your family throughout the trip. Minimum booking 2 days, maximum 7 days.

## Location & Service Areas

Based in Nouvelle-Aquitaine, South West France. Regularly works at wedding venues across Charente, Dordogne, Charente-Maritime and Gironde, including Château de la Côte, Château de la Valouze, Château la Durantie, Manoir de Longeveau, Manoir Beaulieu, Château de Brives, No.3 The Château and Château de la Couronne.

## Key Facts

- 20 years of childcare experience, including as a childminder and foster carer, with knowledge of additional needs support and child development.
- Safeguarding and first aid trained, fully insured and criminal record checked.
- Cares for up to 5 children at a time.
- Gets to know each family in advance through information forms, video calls and messages.
- Two or three day packages are the most popular bookings. A 50% deposit reserves your date.
- Free, no-obligation video call to discuss your childcare needs.
